2607.12625.title: KnowAct-GUIClaw: Know Deeply, Act Perfectly, Personal GUI Assistant with Self-Evolving Memory and Skill
2607.12625.paper_summary: OpenClaw has emerged as a leading agent framework for complex task automation, yet it faces insufficient cross-platform GUI interaction support and a well-built self-evolution mechanism. These flaws limit its adaptation to diverse device ecosystems and prevent performance improvements through continuous learning from execution experience. To resolve these issues, we propose the Know Deeply, Act Perfectly paradigm for personal assistants, which holds that accumulated user interaction and task-running experience directly improve execution accuracy and efficiency, unifying cognitive comprehension and operational execution. Based on this paradigm, we introduce KnowAct-GUIClaw, a novel Know-Route-Act-Reflect framework designed to address OpenClaw's GUI manipulation deficits and break through its cross-platform and recursive self-improvement constraints. First, the host agent leverages accumulated interaction experience and task-relevant knowledge for long-horizon task decomposition and allocation (Know). Second, a pluggable GUI subagent with an experience-attributable memory system (Know) and self-evolving skill library (Act), enabling seamless cross-platform migration and fast-path integration. Especially, this framework continuously stores user profiles and feedback to improve the accuracy of task decomposition and tool calls. Extensive experiments across Android, iOS, HarmonyOS and Windows show that KnowAct-GUIClaw achieves superior efficiency, accuracy and cross-platform adaptability. Especially, the GUIClaw with open-source Kimi-2.6 models achieves the best performance (64.1%) on the long-horizon MobileWorld benchmark, beating all agentical frameworks and closed-source agentical models, e.g., Seed-2.0-Pro and GPT-5.5. Additionally, the knowledgeable memory and execution skills supported by our framework are transferable across diverse base models, improving by 8.5% with Kimi-2.6.
2607.12625.paper_summary_zh: OpenClaw 已經成為複雜任務自動化的領先代理框架，但它面臨著不足的跨平台 GUI 互動支持和完善的自我演化機制。這些缺陷限制了它對多樣設備生態系統的適應性，並阻礙了通過執行經驗的持續學習來提高性能。為了解決這些問題，我們提出了個人助理的 Know Deeply, Act Perfectly 範式，該範式認為累積的用戶互動和任務執行經驗能直接提高執行的準確性和效率，統一認知理解和操作執行。基於這一範式，我們引入了 KnowAct-GUIClaw，一個新穎的 Know-Route-Act-Reflect 框架，旨在解決 OpenClaw 的 GUI 操作缺陷並突破其跨平台和遞歸自我改進的限制。首先，主代理利用累積的互動經驗和任務相關知識進行長期任務的分解和分配（Know）。其次，一個可插拔的 GUI 子代理配備了可歸因於經驗的記憶系統（Know）和自我演化的技能庫（Act），實現無縫的跨平台遷移和快速路徑整合。特別是，這個框架持續存儲用戶檔案和反饋，以提高任務分解和工具調用的準確性。在 Android、iOS、HarmonyOS 和 Windows 上進行的廣泛實驗顯示，KnowAct-GUIClaw 在效率、準確性和跨平台適應性方面表現優越。特別是，使用開源 Kimi-2.6 模型的 GUIClaw 在長期 MobileWorld 基準測試中達到了最佳性能（64.1%），超越了所有代理框架和閉源代理模型，例如 Seed-2.0-Pro 和 GPT-5.5。此外，我們框架支持的知識性記憶和執行技能可以在多樣的基礎模型之間轉移，使用 Kimi-2.6 提高了 8.5%。
